card.name: Inside plastic and polymer names
card.fires_on: Partway through long plastic and polymer names such as polyvinylidene fluoride and polyvinyl chloride, at the piece before the final part. Also fires on a few words that introduce a chemical name.

modes.label: Polymer names
modes.description: Middle piece of poly- names for filters, tubing and containers.

modes.label: Introducing a chemical name
modes.description: A word like called or the start of an abbreviation, just before a chemical name.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next piece of a chemical name, such as chlor- or hyp-, and away from unrelated word pieces.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long plastic names like polyvinyl chloride in compatibility lists.
